name: Checkbox Group
purpose: Coordinate related multi-selection with structured item labels, optional descriptions, native repeated form values, and an optional aggregate parent control.
useWhen: Several independently selectable choices belong to one named group or need a select-all parent.

avoidWhen.condition: The choice is independent and does not share group state.
Exactly one option must be selected.
The interface needs remote option loading, search, or a generated filter engine.

composition: Give Root an accessible group name directly or compose it inside Fieldset with one visible Legend and shared description or error.
Compose Root with Item children; wrap each primary label in ItemLabel and supporting text in ItemDescription when structured item relationships are needed.
Use Parent only with an explicit allValues list containing the currently selectable declared values; omit individually disabled values and never infer the collection from rendered children.

rules.statement: Use Checkbox Group only for related multi-selection; keep one-of-many choice, independent consent, remote search, and application filter execution in their owning patterns.
Give Root a persistent accessible group name and every Item a complete visible associated label; placeholder or surrounding layout does not name the group.
Give every Item a unique stable string value and let the application own persistence, query synchronization, result counts, and filtering side effects.
Supply Parent allValues explicitly from the selectable declared set and do not include disabled choices or derive the set from DOM children.
Use the vertical default for scan-heavy groups and horizontal only when wrapped reading order remains clear under narrow widths, zoom, and localization.
Keep required or invalid messaging at group scope when any eligible option can satisfy the requirement; do not paint every Item as individually invalid.
Load styles.css or core.css plus checkbox-group.css and any Fieldset styles used.

commonMistakes.mistake: Building a filter facet with unrelated standalone checkboxes and no group name.
commonMistakes.correction: Use one named CheckboxGroup.Root with stable Item values and keep query execution in the application.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Parent without an explicit current selectable set.
commonMistakes.correction: Pass allValues deliberately so none, mixed, and all state remain deterministic.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding custom row hover or focus paint around labels.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep the full row clickable while Brick confines visual interaction feedback to the checkbox square.

validation: Inspect the group name, item labels and descriptions, unique values, repeated native form entries, required validity, reset, and disabled or read-only behavior.
Toggle Items and Parent with keyboard, pointer, and touch; verify none, mixed, and all states against the exact declared allValues set.
Check vertical and horizontal wrapping, long localized labels, 320 CSS pixels, 200% text, 400% zoom, RTL, dark appearance, and forced colors.
Confirm application-owned filtering, persistence, URL state, counts, and asynchronous results remain outside Checkbox Group.
